_comment: Illustrative F10 service routines (UDS 0x31). routineId is decimal. verified:false — demo runs them freely; hardware is blocked until you supply a verified definition for your car/I-level. These IDs are templates, not BMW PSdZData.

services.name: Oil service reset
services.description: Reset the Condition Based Service oil interval on the instrument cluster.
services.longDescription: Clears the oil-service CBS item after an oil change. The next reminder is calculated from the car’s remaining CBS data. Demo mode simulates success; on a real car this needs a verified routine ID for your I-level.

services.name: Brake service reset
services.description: Reset the front/rear brake CBS interval after a pad change.
services.longDescription: Marks the brake-service CBS item as done. Codes come back if the wear sensor still reports a fault. Hardware is blocked until the map is verified.
services.warning: Only reset after the pads and wear sensors have actually been replaced.

services.name: Battery registration
services.description: Tell the DME a new battery has been fitted so charging is recalculated.
services.longDescription: After replacing the 12 V battery the DME needs a registration so IBS charging strategy matches the new unit. The bundled routine is illustrative — supply a verified definition (and any payload your car expects) before running it on hardware.
services.warning: Register the battery that is physically installed. A mismatch can under- or over-charge.
